en: The postcard is a sepia-toned historical photograph showing a busy port area with several large ships docked, a prominent building in the foreground, cargo and people visible along the waterfront. The landscape extends to a river or channel with numerous shipping activities. The text at the bottom identifies the scene as a part of the harbor in Göteborg (Gothenburg), Sweden.
